jobs.title: Signature Coordinator - UK
jobs.description: Mission Neko Health is a health technology company that opened its first clinic in Stockholm in 2018, founded by Daniel Ek and Hjalmar Nilsonne. In one hour, our scan combines radiation-free imaging, heart and circulation measurements, and same-visit blood results with time to talk it through with a clinician, so people can act on what matters before symptoms appear. We design and build our own hardware, software and clinical protocols, and more than 100,000 members have already had a scan, with 75% booking and prepaying their next one before they leave. As a team, we chase 10X, not 10%, and we’re looking for people who think the same way to help us scale what we’ve started in Sweden, the UK, and now the US. Join the clinicians, engineers and business builders making prevention a routine part of care. Role Purpose The Neko Signature Coordinator is the operational backbone of the Signature programme. You work behind the scenes so that every booking is set up correctly, every logistical detail is handled, and the Concierge team can focus fully on delivering an exceptional member experience. You are the first to receive and triage enquiries, the person who makes sure nothing falls through the cracks, and the link between the Concierge team, clinic operations, and the member. The role suits someone highly organised and calm under pressure, who is genuinely motivated by getting the details right and can shift priorities without losing accuracy. This role runs on a rotating schedule that includes evenings and weekends. The right person sees that as part of delivering a truly exceptional Signature experience. What You’ll Deliver in the First 6–12 Months Every Signature booking set up correctly and ahead of time in Neko's platforms, with members holding their confirmations, instructions and any personalised requirements well before the visit. jobs.title: Occupational Health & Safety Expert , Fachkraft für Arbeitssicherheit (f/m/d)
jobs.description: We see the potential inside everything and everyone. Starting with you. Orbem uses AI to industrialize MRI, delivering non-invasive insight into everything from fruits to eggs to the human body. We are transforming what is becoming the world's largest biological dataset into actionable intelligence to reduce waste, increase quality, and accelerate the shift toward a more sustainable and healthier future. Headquartered and founded in Munich, Germany, with an office now in Houston, Texas, our world-class team is scaling inside-out technology to transform how humanity sees and understands biological matter. Help us see what's possible. Join us. Your Role As Orbem’s appointed Fachkraft für Arbeitssicherheit, you are responsible for occupational health and safety at all Orbem sites and client installations, from laboratories and MRI environments to the workshop. You are the subject-matter expert Orbem relies on for the hard safety calls: you set the standards, build the systems behind them and lead the safety projects that matter most. You work with a high degree of autonomy. Your impact comes from technical depth, influence and mentoring. You decide independently on risk assessment methods, technical standards and corrective actions, align with management on measures with high cost or cross-team impact, and escalate imminent dangers and legal non-compliance early. Your Day-to-Day Legal Occupational Safety: You perform all duties of a designated occupational safety specialist under § 7 ASiG and ensure compliance with the relevant regulations (ArbSchG, GefStoffV, BioStoffV, StrlSchG, ArbStättV). Safety Strategy & Systems: You own Orbem’s cross-functional OHS: risk assessments, incident management and compliance frameworks, including a legal register, standards, templates and escalation paths. Subject-Matter Expertise: You are the key expert for safety in laboratory and MRI environments (magnetic fields, hazardous and biological substances) and set the standard for quality

Wir unterstützen Patienten mit schweren Erkrankungen und komplexen Diagnosen dabei, die passenden Spezialisten für ihr Anliegen zu finden. Dafür bündeln, strukturieren und analysieren wir qualitätsrelevante Daten aus dem Gesundheitswesen. Seit 2012 haben wir über 100.000 Patienten begleitet. Seit 2022 gehören wir zur Otto Group und arbeiten eng mit unserem Schwesterunternehmen Medgate zusammen, einem der führenden Telemedizin-Anbieter Europas. Du studierst Medizin und probierst nebenbei schon aus, was mit KI alles geht? Bei uns bringst du beides zusammen. Du testest Prompts für echten Datenanfragen, prüfst KI-Ergebnisse mit deinem medizinischen Wissen und baust kleine Prototypen mit. Und du erlebst, wie daraus Produkte werden. Unser Team Medical Science ist der medizinische Kern von BetterDoc. Wir übersetzen medizinisches Wissen in Produkte: strukturierte Daten, Entscheidungslogik und zunehmend KI. Ärztinnen und Ärzte bauen bei uns selbst Prototypen und bringen sie gemeinsam mit Product und Engineering live. Als Werkstudent arbeitest du direkt in diesem Team mit. Zur Verstärkung suchen wir ab sofort einen Werkstudenten (m/w/d) am Standort Köln oder remote. Deine Aufgaben Im Tagesgeschäft Medizinische Datenbank pflegen: Du hältst unsere medizinische Datenbank aktuell. jobs.title: Senior Clinical Product Lead | 100% Remote within Europe
jobs.description: About Docplanner and Noa Docplanner is a global healthcare platform connecting more than 300,000 doctors with approximately 100 million patients every month across 13 markets. Within Docplanner, Noa is on a mission to help people live longer, healthier lives. We build AI that works alongside doctors to: Remove their administrative work. Help them make better decisions and handle repeatable cases, so they can spend their time where it matters most. Help patients navigate healthcare using their medical history as personalized context. We're already in doctors' hands: Noa Notes takes documentation off their plates, while Noa Evidence brings trustworthy medical evidence to the point of care. The next frontier is the hardest—and the most valuable: helping doctors, and eventually patients, make decisions while our AI safely takes on repeatable clinical work. That's where a doctor's judgment has to live inside the product itself. That's this role. About the role You’ll help take Noa from writing notes and providing evidence to helping doctors decide—ensuring what we build fits clinical workflows and earns doctors’ trust. This isn’t a traditional CMO, advisory or regulatory role. It is a hands-on, individual-contributor clinical-product role. You will: Shape doctor-facing products by bringing real clinical needs and workflows into product decisions. Bring clinical judgment to what we build, including what is correct, useful and safe. Because you’re a doctor yourself, you can talk to our users peer-to-peer and get the honest answers a survey never will. As our first dedicated clinical hire on the product, you’ll help establish how clinical expertise informs Docplanner’s AI products. You’ll work day-to-day with Product, AI, Design, Engineering, Regulatory and our doctor network.
